periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Near-vertical orientation with a slight inward tilt of the superior poles toward the midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated tear-drop/oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior expansion; the patch reaches its maximum width in the lower hemisphere before tapering at the top.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse coverage, accounting for approximately one-third of the visible upper-torso verticality.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement; the gap between the dark pinna regions is roughly twice the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The upper boundaries of the pinnae exhibit smooth, convex, semicircular profiles.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown discoloration/staining of the white pelage across the abdominal and inguinal regions.
